title: Senior Quantity Surveyor- Civil (Pre Contract)
minimumQualification: Bachelor’s degree in Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering, or a related.
jobDescription: About Us Egis is an international player active in architecture, consulting, construction engineering and mobility services. We create and operate intelligent infrastructures and buildings that respond to the climate emergency and contribute to more balanced, sustainable and resilient territorial development. Operating in 100 countries, Egis puts the expertise of its 19,500 employees at the service of its clients and develops cutting-edge innovations accessible to all projects. Through its wide range of activities, Egis is a key player in the collective organisation of society and the living environment of citizens all over the world. With 3,500 employees across 8 countries in the Middle East, Egis has delivered over 700 complex development projects, stimulating economic growth and enhancing quality of life. Ranked among the top ten firms in the Middle East by Engineering News Record (ENR), Egis is committed to sustainable development. The Group’s operations in the Middle East are built on strategic acquisitions and a deep understanding of local market conditions. Egis’ long history of providing comprehensive engineering, consulting, and project management services makes it a trusted partner for regional governments, investors, and developers. About the Role We are seeking a skilled Senior Quantity Surveyor- MEP (Pre-Contract) to join our team in the Bangalore team, MESA project support. The role involves managing cost planning, estimating, measurement, and commercial analysis for GCC buildings and infrastructure scope - pre-contract stage. The successful candidate will be responsible for accurate Cost Planning, Bills of Quantities (BOQs), tender documentation, value engineering support, and commercial input to ensure competitive and compliant bids within the GCC. Key Responsibilities Review design drawings, specifications, and scope documents for buildings and infrastructure packages. Perform detailed quantity take-offs at concept, schematic, and detailed / tender design stages. Prepare accurate Bills of Quantities (BOQs) and cost estimates in compliance with POMI, NRM, and CESMM standards as applicable. Support preparation of tender submissions, cost schedules, and rate build-ups. Conduct market research on material, labour, and subcontractor rates within the UAE. Participate in value engineering exercises, identifying cost optimisation opportunities. Assist in drafting tender and contract documents, ensuring commercial accuracy and clarity. Liaise with suppliers and subcontractors to validate rates and quotations. Provide commercial risk assessments, highlight discrepancies, and raise clarifications where required. Support bid review meetings and negotiations with consultants/clients. Maintain accurate cost data, benchmarks, and ensure timely delivery of all pre-contract outputs. What do we need from you Bachelor’s degree in Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering, or a related. Working towards or having achieved professional certification from a recognised body (e.g., MRICS, CIOB). 8–13 years’ experience in pre-contract quantity surveying, preferably in the UAE and KSA, or wider GCC. Strong working knowledge of recognised standards of measurement: POMI, NRM, and CESMM. Proven track record in cost estimation, BOQ preparation, and rate analysis for MEP works and site wide Utilities. Proficiency in measurement and cost management software (CostX). Sound understanding of tendering procedures, subcontractor pricing, and procurement. Apply project BIM standards, the BIM Execution Plan (BEP), naming conventions, and agreed Levels of Development / Information per the model progression schedule. Embed and manage object parameters and attribute data so models are usable for quantity take-off, scheduling, and asset information requirements. Participate in federated model coordination and clash-detection sessions; identify, log, and resolve clashes between disciplines. Maintain model integrity, version control, and revision history within the Common Data Environment (CDE). Produce model-derived outputs: plans, sections, schedules, quantities, and visualisations. Liaise with engineers, designers, BIM Coordinators, and other disciplines to ensure design intent is accurately captured. Support QA/QC checks on models and contributes to continuous improvement of modelling workflows and content libraries. What do we need from you Required Qualifications & Experience Diploma or degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction, Geomatics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Demonstrable experience as a BIM Modeller on rail or transport / linear infrastructure projects. Proven track record delivering models to LOD 350, including modelled system interfaces and connections (not just standalone geometry). Solid understanding of BIM concepts: LOD/LOI, model federation, clash detection, and the ISO 19650 information-management workflow. Strong knowledge of rail-specific elements: track geometry and alignments, turnouts/switches, ballast and sleepers, platforms, overhead line equipment, and corridor/structure interfaces. Ability to read and interpret civil and structural engineering drawings and specifications. Attention to detail, strong spatial awareness, and good coordination/communication skills. Software Proficiency Autodesk: Revit, Civil 3D, InfraWorks, Navisworks (clash detection / coordination) Bentley: OpenRail Designer, MicroStation, ProStructures / OpenBuildings (advantageous for rail projects) Familiarity with a Common Data Environment (e.g., BIM 360 / ACC, ProjectWise, or equivalent) Point-cloud / survey data handling is an advantage What's in it for you? title: Bid Coordinator
minimumQualification: Minimum 3-5 years' experience in bid coordination, bid administration, business development support, or a similar tender-facing role.
jobDescription: About Us Egis is a leading global architectural, consulting, construction engineering, operations and mobility services firm. We create and operate intelligent infrastructure and buildings that both respond to the climate emergency and contribute to balanced, sustainable and resilient development. Our 22,000 employees operate across over 100 countries, deploying their expertise to develop and deliver cutting-edge innovations and solutions for clients. Through the wide range of our activities, we are central to the collective organisation of society and the living environment of citizens all over the world. With 3,500 employees across 8 countries in the Middle East, Egis has delivered over 700 complex development projects, stimulating economic growth and enhancing quality of life. Ranked among the top ten firms in the Middle East by Engineering News Record (ENR), Egis is committed to sustainable development. The Group’s operations in the Middle East are built on strategic acquisitions and a deep understanding of local market conditions. Egis’ long history of providing comprehensive engineering, consulting, and project management services makes it a trusted partner for regional governments, investors, and developers. About the Role The Bid Coordinator carries the operational rhythm of the bid. The role sits at the heart of day-to-day bid delivery - the seat that owns document control, compliance, scheduling and submission logistics, and runs Simple and Simple Plus pursuits end-to-end where the category calls for it. The Bid Coordinator owns the operational backbone of the tender unit's pursuits. The role establishes the SharePoint structure, manages the central inbox and the CRM record, distributes RFP documents and addenda, tracks deliverables against the plan, runs the compliance check against the RFP, and submits the final pack to the client. On Simple and Simple Plus pursuits, the Bid Coordinator runs the bid as the bid runner - chairing the kick-off, holding the rhythm and delivering the submission. On Medium and Complex pursuits, the Bid Coordinator works alongside the Bid Manager or Senior Bid Manager - owning compliance, document control, version management, the colour review packs and the final submission logistics. The role works closely with the wider tender unit, with Technical Leads on technical content collation, with Commercial & Pricing on the price pack, and with Graphics on visual production. The Bid Coordinator is the role the rest of the team relies on for the bid to run smoothly. Compliance and RFP Discipline - Runs the compliance check against the RFP at every stage of the pursuit. Ensures every mandatory requirement is captured, every form completed, every signature in place. Holds the final compliance check before submission. Submission Logistics - Owns the submission process - portal upload, email submission, hand delivery, courier where required. Carries the client confirmation and the internal submission notification. Closes the loop on documentation storage and CRM update post-submission. Schedule and Deliverables Tracking - Tracks deliverables against the bid plan - owners, dates, status, blockers. Runs the daily, bi-daily or weekly check-ins. Surfaces issues to the Bid Manager or Senior Bid Manager early so they can be resolved before they affect submission. CRM and SharePoint Discipline - Owns the operational accuracy of CRM and SharePoint records across every pursuit. Carries the discipline that the rest of the team relies on - opportunity registration, status updates, document storage, archive - as the operational standard of the unit. Tender Collateral and Standard Documents - Owns the standard document pack - trade licence, QA, H&S, ESG, insurances, statutory returns. Keeps the pack current, the CV library accurate and the project experience matrix up to date with input from the Operations Team. Colour Review Pack Production - Produces and distributes the Pink, Red and Gold colour review packs. Captures and logs review comments, distributes the action log, and tracks closeout against actions before submission. Client Portal Management - Leads the oversight, renewal and management of client account portals across the region. Maintains accurate records, ensures compliance with client requirements and supports submission deadlines on every portal-led tender. Document Control and Version Management - Owns document control across every pursuit. Establishes the SharePoint structure, manages version control, keeps the working pack and the issued pack distinct, and protects the integrity of the final submission. What do we need from you Minimum 3-5 years' experience in bid coordination, bid administration, business development support, or a similar tender-facing role. Proven track record running Simple bids end-to-end and supporting Medium and Complex pursuits as the document control and compliance owner. Excellent organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent pursuits. Strong attention to detail across compliance, document control and submission logistics. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, SharePoint, CRM systems and client portal management. Familiarity with the Middle East tendering environment and procurement frameworks. Clear written and verbal communication skills - professional and confident with internal stakeholders and clients. Ability to work independently and as part of a multi-discipline team. minimumQualification: Education: Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related field.
jobDescription: About Us Egis is a leading global consulting, construction engineering and operating firm. We work together with our clients, across every aspect of transport, energy, and the built environment to build a more balanced, sustainable, and resilient world. The Egis Group has more than 50 years of experience and a team of 22,000 employees in over 120 countries around the world. Joining our Group means, above all, sharing our values as a people-first company, strongly committed to sustainability and innovation. In the UK we're proud to be delivering some of the most iconic projects which help connect people, protect our environment, and meet emission reduction targets. From motorways to tramways, and nuclear power plants to smart cities, clients choose us to help them solve their most complex challenges - delivering climate-responsible growth that meets the needs of communities, industry and the planet. About the Role The Senior Integration Developer is responsible for the development, maintenance, and support of integrations and extensions within the EARTH ecosystem, covering Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP/HCM, satellite applications, middleware, reporting, and BI tools. Based in Bangalore and reporting to the Integration Leader, the role contributes to the design, implementation, testing, documentation, and run support of robust, scalable, secure, and maintainable integration solutions using Oracle Cloud technologies such as Oracle Integration Cloud, VBCS, REST/SOAP APIs, BI Publisher, OTBI, and related data services. Working closely with the Integration Leader, Solution Architect, functional experts, L2/L3 support teams, and external partners, the Senior Integration Developer supports the full Build-to-Run lifecycle and contributes to the stabilization, industrialization, and long-term internalization of Oracle / EARTH Run and Build capabilities. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Integration Development and Maintenance Develop, maintain, and enhance Oracle Fusion Cloud integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud, REST/SOAP APIs, VBCS, and related Oracle Cloud technologies. ▪ Implement and maintain CEMLI components, including extensions, interfaces, conversions, reports, and data extracts. Design reusable, secure, scalable, and high-performing integration flows aligned with architecture principles and integration standards. Reports, Extracts and Data Services Develop and maintain reports, extracts, and analytics components using BI Publisher, OTBI, BICC, SQL, PL/SQL, and related reporting tools. Support data transformation, mapping, reconciliation, traceability, and quality control across interfaces and connected applications. Contribute to the reliability and maintainability of data flows across Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP/HCM and the broader EARTH ecosystem. Incident Investigation and Run Support Investigate incidents related to interfaces, data flows, reports, integrations, technical extensions, and middleware components. Identify root causes, propose corrective and preventive actions, and contribute to the reduction of recurring incidents. Ensure that developments are supportable, documented, monitored, and aligned with Build-to-Run expectations before production deployment. Technical Documentation and Knowledge Transfer Create and maintain clear technical documentation, interface specifications, runbooks, and knowledge base content. Contribute to knowledge sharing, onboarding, and shift-left practices within the integration team and Run organization. Support the progressive internalization of Oracle / EARTH technical capabilities within the Bangalore competence center. Continuous Improvement and AI-Enabled Practices Operate as part of the global Oracle / EARTH competence center while supporting international delivery and support priorities. Use AI-enabled tools responsibly to accelerate technical analysis, improve development quality, support code or configuration review, and automate repetitive activities. Contribute to improved monitoring, alerting, operational control, and continuous improvement loops across integration and reporting activities. Promote industrialized, reusable, and maintainable development practices aligned with integration standards. Collaboration and Governance Collaborate with the Integration Leader, Solution Architect, Business Analysts, functional experts, Run teams, project teams, data teams, and external partners. In this strategic role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle of our support services, covering critical business functions like Finance, Project Portfolio Management (PPM), and Human Capital Management (HCM). This is a high-visibility role for a transformational leader, offering the opportunity to shape a new global capability centre and work extensively with international stakeholders. Team Setup & Leadership ▪ Recruit & Scale: Lead the end-to-end recruitment and onboarding strategy to build a team of 25-50 FTEs by the end of 2026, establishing a robust talent pipeline. ▪ Mentorship: Identify, mentor, and develop a Deputy Manager to ensure operational resilience, business continuity, and succession planning. ▪ People Management: Act as the single point of accountability for team performance, capacity planning, workload distribution, and workforce management, including attrition and absence management. ▪ Culture Building: Forge a high-performance team culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, and an unwavering commitment to service excellence. Transition & Knowledge Transfer ▪ Structured Transition: Define and execute a comprehensive knowledge transfer plan (3-6 months) from our incumbent service provider, ensuring a seamless and risk-free transition of all support activities. ▪ Progressive Takeover: Lead a phased, parallel-run approach to take full ownership of the support function, validating team readiness and process maturity at each stage. ▪ Documentation & Enablement: Ensure the creation and maintenance of a robust knowledge base, comprehensive system documentation, and training materials to empower the team. Service Delivery & Operations (L2 Support) ▪ End-to-End Service Ownership: Manage the full lifecycle of Oracle ERP support, including: Incident & Problem Management: Ensure resolution aligns with strict SLAs and KPI targets (availability, resolution time, CSAT, etc.). Change & Release Management: Oversee the intake, prioritization, and execution of change requests, including the management of quarterly patching cycles and environment refreshes. Technical Stewardship: Coordinate with middleware, data, and infrastructure teams to manage integrations (APIs, OIC) and ensure system stability. Reporting & Analytics: Manage the delivery of critical reports and dashboards using OTBI and BI Publisher, providing actionable insights to stakeholders. Process, Tools & Performance Management ▪ ITIL Framework: Define, implement, and continuously improve ITIL-aligned processes (Incident, Problem, Change, Knowledge, Service Level Management). ▪ Tooling & Metrics: Deploy and optimize ITSM tools to automate workflows, enhance reporting, and provide real time visibility into service performance. ▪ Continuous Improvement: Champion a culture of continuous improvement by identifying automation opportunities, eliminating manual processes, and leveraging agentic AI capabilities to enhance efficiency. ▪ Governance & Reporting: Deliver regular, data-driven performance reports to senior leadership and global governance bodies. Stakeholder & Ecosystem Management ▪ Global Interface: Serve as the primary point of contact for global IT leadership, business stakeholders, and European partners, effectively bridging time zones and cultural differences. ▪ Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams including Solution Architects, Business Analysts, Middleware, and Data & Infrastructure teams to ensure cohesive service delivery. ▪ Strategic Contribution: Actively contribute to the strategic direction of the Global IT Applications group, positioning the Bangalore center as a key strategic asset. Context & Organizational Positioning • The role is part of a strategic transformation program to build an India-centric GCC model (≈85% India footprint) • The manager is a key operational leader within the Global IT organization • The position interacts daily with international stakeholders, especially in Europe • The organization aims to build long-term internal capabilities and reduce dependency on external vendors What do we need from you Education: Bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field. Experience: 10+ years of total experience, with at least 10+ years in a leadership role managing Oracle ERP support services. Preferred Certification: ITIL v3/v4 Certification; Oracle Cloud certifications (e.g., Financials, HCM) are a significant plus. What's in it for you? ▪ Proven experience in building, scaling, and leading L2/L3 support teams of 20+ FTEs in a global delivery model. ▪ Deep, hands-on experience in managing Oracle Cloud ERP support services, specifically across Finance, PPM, and HCM modules. ▪ Strong background in Application Management Services (AMS) or support factory models. ▪ Demonstrated experience in managing complex transitions or Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) projects, ideally in consulting or system integration firms. ▪ Must have experience collaborating with European stakeholders (Ideally French) and navigating multicultural, matrixed environments. Technical & Functional Expertise Deep Domain Knowledge: Expert understanding of Oracle Cloud ERP (Finance, PPM, HCM) and its underlying architecture. ▪ ITIL Mastery: Strong command of ITIL service lifecycle processes, specifically Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Management. ▪ Technical Acumen: Working knowledge of integration technologies (APIs, OIC), environment management, and reporting tools (OTBI, BI Publisher). ▪ SLA Management: Proven track record of managing KPI and SLA-driven support models, with a focus on service quality and customer satisfaction. Leadership & Soft Skills ▪ Structured & Analytical: Strong organizational skills with a data-driven approach to problem-solving and decision making. ▪ Inspirational Leader: A natural people leader with a talent for recruiting, mentoring, and motivating diverse, high performing teams. ▪ Exceptional Communicator: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to articulate complex technical issues to senior executives. ▪ Strategic & Execution-Oriented: A visionary leader who can define a clear roadmap and also roll up their sleeves to drive execution in a transformation context. ▪ Resilient & Adaptable: Possesses high ownership, accountability, and the ability to navigate ambiguity and manage change effectively. Success Metrics (First 12-18 Months) Successful recruitment, build-out, and stabilization of the Bangalore L2 support team. Seamless and timely completion of knowledge transfer and full operational transition. Achievement of target headcount and operational readiness by the end of 2026. Consistent compliance with defined SLA/KPI targets for service quality and delivery performance. title: Sr .Traffic & Transportation Engineer
minimumQualification: Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering / Transportation Engineering (Master’s preferred).
jobDescription: About Us Great Platform for Talent About the Role Role Overview Lead traffic engineering and transport planning tasks for major infrastructure projects, with a strong focus on Dubai RTA-compliant Temporary Traffic Management (TTM), diversions, and traffic staging, alongside permanent traffic impact assessments (TIA), junction analysis, access planning, and traffic signage/road markings coordination. The role will support design development, authority approvals, and construction-phase traffic management in close coordination with highways, utilities, and construction teams. Key Responsibilities Lead delivery of Traffic Impact Assessments (TIA) and supporting technical studies for road and transport infrastructure projects (greenfield and brownfield). Develop and manage TTM / work zone traffic management deliverables, including: Diversion plans, detour layouts, staging/phasing plans, lane closure schemes, and construction access/egress arrangements Temporary signage and road marking plans, traffic control devices, safety barriers, and pedestrian management (where applicable) Methodology narratives, risk assessments, and sequencing aligned with construction methodology and site constraints Manage Dubai RTA coordination and approvals for TTM/diversions, including preparation of submission packages, responding to RTA comments, and aligning with RTA requirements, standards, and typical details. Perform junction and corridor analysis (existing and forecast), including capacity, LOS, queues, delays, and operational performance under base and construction-stage scenarios. Undertake traffic surveys scoping and interpretation: turning counts, mid-block counts, travel time runs, parking demand, pedestrian counts, heavy vehicle counts; develop calibrated base models where required. Develop traffic modelling and scenario testing for: Permanent scheme impacts (new intersections, access points, ramp terminals, weaving sections) Construction-stage impacts (temporary lane drops, detours, signal timing changes, partial closures) Mitigation measures (signal optimization, geometry refinements, temporary signal plans, reversible lanes where permissible) Prepare signage and road marking design inputs and reviews, including: Permanent guide signs, regulatory/warning signs, VMS interface needs (if applicable), and pavement marking strategy Temporary signage for work zones/diversions in accordance with RTA expectations and safety practice Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams: highways geometric design, utilities, structures, construction planning, safety, and stakeholder interfaces (developers, local authorities, police/ambulance access requirements where applicable). Provide construction support: review contractor TTM submissions, respond to RFIs, participate in site coordination meetings, and support implementation readiness checks. Prepare deliverables and governance documentation: design reports, TIA reports, concept/IFC drawings, phasing narratives, traffic management plans, and authority submission trackers. title: CAD Technician
jobDescription:
About Us Join Egis, where your ambition meets unparalleled growth opportunities. As we continue to expand within Canada, we're looking for talented professionals like you to be a part of our innovative team. Imagine working alongside over 1,000 top-tier engineers, architects, and planners, all dedicated to shaping the future of infrastructure and development. At Egis, your skills and aspirations will find the perfect environment to thrive. Elevate your career with us and be a driving force in our exciting journey. Our values showcase everything we believe in: A Responsible Company - We care about people, and we care about our impact; acting responsibly wherever we work and whatever we do. A People-First Company - This is an environment of mutual respect where every team member matters, no matter who they are. A Creative Company - Creativity is in our DNA. This is the fuel that helps us tackle the major challenges of our time. About the Role Assisting senior and intermediate staff with engineering design on a variety of transportation projects. Preparing AutoCAD drawings and item quantity calculations used for tender and Construction. Quality control according to engineering specifications and client requirements under the direction and supervision of a senior designer or engineer. Responsible for drafting quality control and interface with other disciplines. Responsible for keeping up with industry updates and current software, as well as internal processes. Preparing highway designs for various types of facilities using current design software. Providing design support on transportation projects and becoming familiarized with client Standards. Maintaining positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders. Collaborating with design teams within other operating locations in Ontario. What do we need from you Minimum 3 to 5 years of progressive consulting experience completing linear transportation projects Ability to read and understand survey plans and drawings. Proficiency in the use of AutoCAD and Civil 3D software would be considered a strong asset.  Demonstrated abilities in multidisciplinary project teamwork and coordination. Excellent oral and written communication skills in English. Strong attention to detail, problem solving skills and ability to think creatively. Ability to work effectively independently or as part of a team. What's in it for you? Egis Canada is an equal opportunities employer offering a competitive salary and benefits to those with the skills suited to the needs of our clients. Apply project QA/QC and governance: ensure document control compliance, traceability of assumptions, and effective management of design change impacts on telecom architecture.
